name: Wordmark under strain
look: A closing word in giant type is held and put under load by the scroll: it is crushed onto its baseline and springs back, and its full stop loosens, falls out and lands flat as the call-to-action button, leaving the word whole. It is the closing moment of a page for a loud brand: the word is the page's last call, never the brand's name.
reduced: The finished composition: the markup as the page writes it, nothing moving.
phone: The same strain with phone numbers and no echo: the word fitted to the width (narrower if the face has a width axis), its full stop falling into the button under the word's centre, the meta row in two lines; hold 1.
place: At the end of the page, as the call to action; the footer after it keeps the same ground. Once per page. For a loud brand only (a band, a race or a sports brand, a studio that shouts): never deal it to a calm house, a guesthouse, a craft or a care practice, where the strain reads as a broken word. At rest the word reads whole.
content: One word of 4-8 letters (4-6 best), a closing word and never the brand's name (a giant name fails giant-contact), in capitals, best with no I, l or 1. A square full stop is added after it, hangs in the margin and is what falls, so the word rests whole and centred. A button label of 2-3 words, 18 characters at most; a sentence of 45 characters or more about the offer and a place line for the top row; a meta row of three short items (an email, a city, a link). Type only: one heavy display face, one flat ground shared with what follows, one ink at 7:1, an optional accent for the landed button.
options: hold 1 (1-4); phoneHold 1 (1-2); phone 'same' | 'rest'; scrub 0.8, true with Lenis; echo false (true adds the stepped echo of stacked copies at 768px and wider; it reads as a winged badge, so leave it off); copies 6 (4-8) in the echo; step 1/13 (1/16-1/9) scale each copy loses; shift 2 (1-4) % of the word's height each copy sinks; squash 0.14 (0-0.15), 0.10 with echo; spring 3 (1.5-3); drop true (false keeps the word as it is and the button under it from the start); letter 'stop' | 'straight' | index, what falls ('stop', an added square full stop, keeps the word whole; 'straight' drops its I, l or 1 and leaves a gap); size [300, 64] the landed button in px, phoneSize [240, 52]; radius 0 (0-8); accent '', the button's colour as it lands; reveal 'wipe' | 'fade', on a 0.4s clock once the bar is flat; fill 0.92 (0.8-0.96); maxHeight 0.42 (0.3-0.45); stretch 'normal'; phoneStretch 'condensed'.
